title: Deterministic plan summary for thin workflow consumption
description: The stable, flat surface `release.py render-plan` derives from a prepare or finish plan. Every field is a plain string so a thin workflow can map it directly to a step/job output with `jq -r '.field'` without knowing the full plan schema.

toolingSha.description: The trusted tooling commit the source plan was generated from.

releaseIdentity.description: The normalized release identity: the exact release version/branch without the CI build revision. Stable for a given release across preview/RC/stable/hotfix and safe to use as a repository-wide concurrency key.

releaseVersion.description: Prepare: the exact release version (same as releaseIdentity). Finish: the exact requested public NuGet.org version, including the CI build revision.

digest.description: The canonical digest of the source plan this summary was rendered from, unchanged from the plan file.
